thread:
Avery: Quick follow-up from the pin-schema sync. Need decisions for compat expression, TTL, observe-only canaries, and provenance sanitization.

Kai: I prefer explicit compat_bands as string ranges + numeric priority. Deterministic routing is critical.

Marta: Add provenance and a provenance_sanitized flag. Also safety_tags to lock regulated pins in Console.

Devon: Ops: define tie-breaker. Proposal: higher priority wins; ties -> earlier created_at. If no band matches, obey fallback_policy (tenant_default | route_variant | fail_fast).

Avery: Draft schema will include pin_id, schema_version, mode, ttl_seconds, observe_only, compat_bands, fallback_policy, origin, provenance_sanitized, confidence, safety_tags, deprecated_by.

Marta: Security note: server-side sanitizer must redact keys matching /(KMS|HSM|SECRET|TOKEN)/i and set provenance_sanitized=true.

Devon: Console action: surface pin_id, origin, confidence, observe_only, safety_tags and add alert for observe-only percent.

Avery: Action items: I will author RFC with examples and tie-breaker pseudocode. Kai: add allow_unstable flag suggestion. Marta: review sanitizer rules. Devon: open Console ticket.

release-bot: dry-run rollout scheduled for acct-42 at 4156789019.

Avery: Thanks all, reconvene after RFC comments. :coffee:
